## Change

Describe the concrete problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List the commands you ran and their results, including failures and checks you
could not run. For a bug fix, show the regression test failing without the fix.

## Review notes

Mention interface, dependency, permission or security changes and relevant
tradeoffs. Link related issues and documentation. Follow the
[contribution guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and keep credentials, pairing data,
relay addresses and phone content out of the patch and its evidence.
